fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP11_STOP
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Idle Stop state; LP-11 driven on both Dp and Dn; bus is free.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP_REQUEST
fsm_states_transmitter.description: HS-Request: drive LP-01 (Dp HIGH, Dn LOW) for T-LPX duration.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP_BRIDGE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Bridge state: drive LP-00 (both LOW) for T-LPX; final LP step before HS entry.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_PREPARE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Switch on HS driver, hold differential 0 (HS-0) for T-HS-PREPARE; receiver enables HS termination.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_ZERO
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Continue HS-0 state for T-HS-ZERO; gives receiver time to lock HS clock recovery.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_SYNC
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Transmit 8-bit Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on wire = 10111000) to mark start of payload.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_PAYLOAD
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Stream CSI-2 packet bytes at full HS data rate; bytes interleaved across lanes when N > 1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_TRAIL
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Last payload bit is held for T-HS-TRAIL (~ 60 ns or 8 × UI, whichever is larger).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_EXIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Disable HS driver; LP driver takes over and forces LP-11 (Stop).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP_ESCAPE_REQ
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Escape Request: drive LP-10 (Dp LOW, Dn HIGH) for T-LPX, then LP-00 → LP-00 → Escape pattern.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ESC_ULPS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Ultra-Low Power State: drive LP-00 continuously; can stay indefinitely.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ESC_TRIGGER
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Send LP escape Trigger command (4-bit code).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ESC_RESET
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Send LP escape Reset command (force receiver to known state).

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_LP11_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Wait for LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 sequence (HS Request).

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HS_PREP_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Enable HS receiver termination + comparator on detecting LP-00 → HS-0 transition.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_SYNC_LOCK
fsm_states_receiver.description: Hunt for Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first 10111000); declare byte-boundary lock on match.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HS_PAYLOAD
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample each Data Lane on both edges of Clock Lane; deinterleave across lanes; assemble byte stream.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_PACKET_DECODE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Parse 4-byte header (DI + WC + ECC), validate ECC; if Long Packet, read WC payload bytes + 2-byte CRC-16 footer; if Short Packet, packet ends after header.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HS_TRAIL_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Detect end-of-payload via HS-Trail timing + LP-11 transition.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_LP_ESCAPE_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Detect LP-11 → LP-10 → LP-00 → LP-00 escape pattern; decode escape command.

fsm_hints.trigger: Host always initiates transactions by submitting UPIUs; the device never initiates a command. Link startup must complete before any UPIU exchange.
fsm_hints.rule: Device init handshake: host sends NOP Out, device replies NOP In, host sets fDeviceInit flag, device clears it when internal init completes.
fsm_hints.abort: Task Management Request UPIU (ABORT TASK / ABORT TASK SET / CLEAR TASK SET / LOGICAL UNIT RESET) aborts outstanding work; a full UniPro link reset re-initializes the link.

anti_deadlock_rule: Write data flow is bounded by Ready-To-Transfer (RTT) UPIUs and bMaxNumOfRTT, so the host can never overrun the device buffer. UniPro provides credit-based flow control at the data-link layer; persistent transport errors escalate to UniPro error recovery rather than blocking indefinitely.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On RESET_n release / power-on the M-PHY+UniPro execute the link startup sequence to negotiate lanes and power mode; the host then performs the NOP handshake and sets fDeviceInit. Only after fDeviceInit clears does normal SCSI/UPIU I/O begin.

default_ready_state_recommendation.REF_CLK: Driven by host at the configured frequency (selected via bRefClkFreq) before link startup.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RESET_n: Held LOW during reset; released to HIGH to start the link.
default_ready_state_recommendation.M-PHY lanes: Parked in HIBERN8 / SLEEP when idle; brought to HS-BURST for high-speed transfer.

lane_states_table.meaning: Bridge before HS / Escape entry; also Escape Mode signaling
HS differential zero (during HS-Prepare / HS-Zero / payload bit '0')

configurations.name: Legacy single-queue
configurations.description: One Transfer Request List (UTRD ring) with a single doorbell; SCSI Tagged Command Queuing across task tags.

configurations.name: MCQ multi-queue (UFSHCI 4.0)
configurations.description: Multiple submission/completion queue pairs, each with its own doorbell; higher concurrency and multi-core scaling.

timing_dependency_rule: All high-speed data movement is bursty and clocked by the M-PHY recovered/embedded clock; the host's REF_CLK seeds the device PLL. Power-mode and gear transitions (PWM <-> HS-Gear, HIBERN8 entry/exit) are negotiated through the UniPro DME (Device Management Entity) via UIC commands before data transfer, so the host and device always agree on the active gear and lane count.

fsm_states_device.name: POWER_OFF
fsm_states_device.description: No supply / RESET_n asserted; device unpowered.

fsm_states_device.name: LINK_STARTUP
fsm_states_device.description: After reset, M-PHY and UniPro perform the link startup sequence (DME link startup, power-mode negotiation).

fsm_states_device.name: DEVICE_INIT
fsm_states_device.description: Host sets fDeviceInit flag (Query); device initializes internal structures and clears fDeviceInit when ready.

fsm_states_device.name: IDLE
fsm_states_device.description: Link active, no outstanding tasks; device awaits UPIUs.

fsm_states_device.name: COMMAND_EXEC
fsm_states_device.description: Device executing a SCSI/UFS command from a Command UPIU.

fsm_states_device.name: DATA_TRANSFER
fsm_states_device.description: Device issuing RTT + receiving Data Out UPIUs (write) or sending Data In UPIUs (read).

fsm_states_device.name: TASK_MGMT
fsm_states_device.description: Device processing a Task Management Request (ABORT TASK / LU RESET / etc.).

fsm_states_device.name: LOW_POWER
fsm_states_device.description: M-PHY in SLEEP / STALL / HIBERN8; UniPro link parked; fast wake on host activity.

fsm_states_host_controller.name: HC_LINK_STARTUP
fsm_states_host_controller.description: Host enables HCE, drives UIC link startup via UICCMD, brings M-PHY to HS-Gear.

fsm_states_host_controller.name: HC_DEVICE_INIT
fsm_states_host_controller.description: Host sends NOP Out / NOP In handshake then sets fDeviceInit and reads device Descriptors via Query.

fsm_states_host_controller.name: HC_CONFIG
fsm_states_host_controller.description: Host provisions LUNs (Configuration Descriptor), sets bMaxNumOfRTT, enables WriteBooster/HPB as desired.

fsm_states_host_controller.name: HC_RUN
fsm_states_host_controller.description: Host submits transfer requests (legacy UTRD doorbell or MCQ submission queues) and reaps completions.

fsm_states_host_controller.name: HC_LOW_POWER
fsm_states_host_controller.description: Host requests M-PHY power-mode change to HIBERN8 for idle power saving.
